rubrics.justification: Describes a good-quality expanded blastocyst with thinning zona, visible but not sharply defined ICM, and reasonably cohesive TE without obvious degeneration; appropriately notes uncertainty from a static image. Minor issue is some ambiguity around stage 3 vs 4 interpretation.
Strongly integrates maternal age, prior miscarriage, AMH/FSH, BMI, endometrial thickness, male factor, paternal age, and oocyte maturity with embryo morphology and prognosis.

Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, especially emphasizing age-related aneuploidy as the main limiter despite good morphology. Minor softness around linking morphology-stage ambiguity to prognosis, but conclusions are well supported.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice: single embryo transfer, counseling on age-related aneuploidy, luteal support, and selective discussion of PGT-A. Small deviations include slightly casual wording around stage nomenclature and some recommendations that are center-dependent rather than guideline-driven.
Provides clear next steps for current transfer and future planning, including SET, luteal support, early monitoring, miscarriage review, male-factor workup, and protocol reassessment if unsuccessful.
